name: Rapid consumer credit drawdown with no stated purpose
description: Customer takes several unsecured loans, credit cards or overdraft limits in a short window and withdraws or transfers the proceeds quickly, then ceases repayment.
fp: Common in financial distress, gambling or fraud victimisation; most such patterns are not terrorism related.
